 IonQ: Quantum Progress Meets Unnecessary Shareholder Dilution (Rating Downgrade)
 Nov 17, 2026, 8:09 AM ET IonQ, Inc. (IONQ) Stock 11 Comments 1 Like Melissa Tucker 2.08K Followers Follow Summary
 I downgrade IonQ to Buy and cut short-term fair value to $40, or roughly 34 times sales, despite long-term optimism.
 IONQ’s $2 billion financing bolsters liquidity but brings roughly 12% dilution, with similar potential dilution if warrants are exercised.
 IONQ advanced to DARPA Stage C and demonstrated a real-time quantum error decoder; its 10,000-qubit roadmap remains a critical catalyst.
 da-kuk/E+ via Getty Images
